This portfolio contains four substantial projects covering topics from Sections 1 and 2. Together, the projects demonstrate **model comparison, computational and statistical programming, simulation, forecasting, and the analysis of real-world data**.

| # | Title | Section | Type | Involves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Forecasting Influenza Cases in Australia](project-01/index.qmd) | 1 & 2 | Implementation / Exploration / Forecasting Study | Model comparison / Forecasting / Real-world data |
| 2 | [GARCH Modelling of Financial Data](project-02/index.qmd) | 1 | Implementation / Model Comparison / Simulation Study | Statistical programming / Model comparison / Simulation / Real-world data |
| 3 | [Crime and Economic Indicators in South Africa](project-03/index.qmd) | 2 | Exploration / Real-World Data Analysis / Forecasting Study | ARIMAX / Model comparison / Forecasting / Real-world data |
| 4 | [State Estimation Under Uncertainty: A Simulation Study of the Kalman Filter](project-04/index.qmd) | 2 | Implementation / Exploration / Simulation Study | Statistical programming / Simulation / Model comparison |
